segments.sn4.22:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati silāvatiyaṃ.
segments.sn4.22:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā samiddhi bhagavato avidūre appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharati.
segments.sn4.22:1.3: Atha kho āyasmato samiddhissa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.sn4.22:1.6: Lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me,

segments.sn4.22:1.10: Atha kho māro pāpimā āyasmato samiddhissa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya yenāyasmā samiddhi tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmato samiddhissa avidūre mahantaṃ bhayabheravaṃ saddamakāsi, apissudaṃ pathavī maññe undrīyati.
segments.sn4.22:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā samiddhi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno āyasmā samiddhi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn4.22:2.2: “idhāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato avidūre appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharāmi.
segments.sn4.22:2.3: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.sn4.22:2.6: Lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me,

segments.sn4.22:3.2: Māro eso pāpimā tuyhaṃ vicakkhukammāya āgato.
segments.sn4.22:3.3: Gaccha tvaṃ, samiddhi, tattheva appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharāhī”ti.

lines: Dutiye lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata meti evarūpassa satthu ceva dhammassa ca sabrahmacārīnañca laddhattā mayhaṃ lābhā mayhaṃ suladdhanti.
So kirāyasmā pacchā mūlakammaṭṭhānaṃ sammasitvā “arahattaṃ gahessāmī”ti pāsādikaṃ tāva kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā buddhadhammasaṅghaguṇe āvajjetvā cittakallataṃ uppādetvā cittaṃ hāsetvā tosetvā nisinno.
Upasaṅkamīti “ayaṃ samiddhi bhikkhu pāsādikaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā nisinnasadiso, yāva mūlakammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā arahattaṃ na gaṇhāti, tāvassa antarāyaṃ karissāmī”ti upasaṅkami.
Gaccha tvanti satthā sakalajambudīpaṃ olokento “tasmiṃyeva ṭhāne tassa kammaṭṭhānaṃ sappāyaṃ bhavissatī”ti addasa, tasmā evamāha.
Satipaññā ca me buddhāti mayā sati ca paññā ca ñātā.
Neva maṃ byādhayissasīti maṃ neva vedhayissasi na kampassesi.

lines: Mayhaṃ lābhāti evarūpassa nāma sammāsambuddhassa satthussa paṭilābho, evarūpassa ca nāma niyyānikassa saddhammassa paṭilābho, evarūpānañca suppaṭipannānaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ paṭilābho, ete mayhaṃ suladdhalābhā.
Mayhaṃ suladdhanti yañcetaṃ mama niyyānikasāsane pabbajjā upasampadā, tasmiñca abhiratīti sabbañcetaṃ mayā suladdhaṃ.
Yathā panassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko uppanno, taṃ dassetuṃ “so kirā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tasmiṃyeva ṭhāneti yasmiṃ ṭhāne nisinnaṃ māro upasaṅkami, tasmiṃyeva ṭhāne.
Kammaṭṭhānaṃ sappāyanti kammaṭṭhānabhāvanāya anuyuñjanaṃ sappāyaṃ upakārāvahaṃ bhavissati.
Sati ca paññā ca satipaññā, tā ariyamaggena jānanasamatthanabhāvena avabuddhā.
Keci “kāmaṃ karassūti āyasmato ‘kāmā’ti mārassa ālapana”nti vadanti.
Vippakāratthopi hi rūpasaddo “rūpaṃ dasseti anappaka”ntiādīsu viya.
